requestPath.autoRouterModelsBehavior: Intentionally exposes only 6 AutoRouter virtual models (auto, code, analysis, fast, explore, research). Rejects concrete models with HTTP 400 invalid_model.
requestPath.upstreamGatewayModelsBehavior: Exposes complete concrete inventory (39 models discovered). Accepts and executes concrete model IDs.

profileCoverage.caseG3Fix: Refined classify() so concurrency, SQL, and code keywords take precedence over casual transformation substrings; updated riskOf() for financial/invoice risks; expanded strong/frontier taskFit to include transformation.
profileCoverage.registryValidation: Added validateProfileCoverage() to verify that each supported routing class and hard-capability combination has at least one valid execution path across all quality tiers.
profileCoverage.structuredFallback: Replaced runtime exception with structured fallback decision (fallbackEngaged: true, fallbackReason), preserving system availability and explicit observability.

resumeAndTimeoutIsolation.timeoutIsolation: Bounded per-request AbortSignal.timeout; records INFRA_TIMEOUT and elapsedMs without halting runner

rebuiltRubrics.codeInvariants: Deterministic validation, null-safety guards, capacity clamping, ISO format & calendar validation
rebuiltRubrics.secondaryJudgeRule: Candidate model cannot judge itself; fixed judge used strictly as secondary signal with judge model, rubric, decision, and reason persisted.

reviewVariants.evidence: Catalog metadata shows identical context windows, capabilities, and parameters to base models; completion probe demonstrates identical behavior without distinct architectural execution profile.
